name: Quick-Witted's stab triggers Searing Quiver's Fire Arrows (#13043)
contract: Quick-Witted 704311 (Ranger, Brigand) fires its stab 704314 when you avoid an attack. #13043 reports that
the stab did not apply the quiver's effects. Searing Quiver 500103 tooltips that ranged abilities deal $s1%
(15%) additional direct Fire damage as Fire Arrows 681109, computed from the damage the hit actually dealt;
the stab is DmgClass 3 (ranged) but triggered, which the Ranger quiver hit handler skipped. Expected: the
first stab is followed by exactly one Fire Arrows worth 15% of the stab's dealt damage. Melee, ranged and
spell crit rating fixtures make every Fire Arrows a critical hit (a damage class 3 spell outside the Hunter
family rolls on the main hand attack type) (twice the amount for a ranged damage class spell), so the
critical/non-critical ambiguity is removed. Resists are removed too: the test spell penetration aura 823764
(-9999 target resistance) cancels the linear monster resistance, and the setup checks that the mob meets the
ranger's Fire spells with no average resist (spell_resist_chance 0) and that the measured Fire Arrows had
nothing resisted or absorbed. The pair must then land between 20% and 30.5%: at most twice 15% (the critical
bonus can be trimmed by the target's crit damage reduction, so the floor sits well above the 15% of a
non-critical hit). A doubled percentage (about 60%), a missing critical (15%) and a second Fire Arrows per
stab all fail. Before the fix no Fire Arrows followed the stab at all. The mob has 1,000,000 health so
overkill never trims the stab, Evasion (5277, +50% dodge) makes avoided attacks frequent, the ranger never
attacks, so the Fire Arrows can only come from the stab, and hit rating fixtures keep it from missing.
